subject: statistical measure of a "morphology burst" (unequal frequency distribution in a longitudinal learner corpus)

messages.author: 77d31881a8145c12
messages.subject: statistical measure of a "morphology burst" (unequal frequency distribution in a longitudinal learner corpus)
parts:
Hi everyone

I've got a very unequal distribution of the basic verb sapere "know" in my longitudinal corpus of L2 Italian. Until I certain point, a learner uses exclusively the chunk io non so "I do not know". She keeps on overusing this chunk to express other verb forms and meanings for about 4 months. Then from a certain point on, this learner starts inflecting the chunk and morphology appears all in a sudden. My point is that there could be a sort of discontinuity in the acquisition of morphology. My question is: which is the proper statistical tool in R (and relative graph, if possible) to ascertain whether there is a real discontinuity in these distributions?

Thank you so much in advance!!
ciao
Stefano
